mapper.select: SELECT id, account_id, instrument_id, quantity, available_quantity, frozen_quantity, average_cost, realized_pnl FROM quantpf_position WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND instrument_id=#{instrumentId}

SELECT id, account_id, instrument_id, quantity, available_quantity, frozen_quantity, average_cost, realized_pnl FROM quantpf_position WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND instrument_id=#{instrumentId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quantpf_position (account_id, instrument_id, quantity, available_quantity, frozen_quantity, average_cost, realized_pnl) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{instrumentId}, #{quantity}, #{availableQuantity}, #{frozenQuantity}, #{averageCost}, #{realizedPnl})
mapper.update: UPDATE quantpf_position SET quantity=#{quantity}, available_quantity=#{availableQuantity}, frozen_quantity=#{frozenQuantity}, average_cost=#{averageCost}, realized_pnl=#{realizedPnl} WHERE id=#{id}
